AIMLDS

The official F-Droid repository of AIMLDS (2351485 Alberta Inc.) - privacy-first Android apps by Nrupal Akolkar. Apps here are built from public source, signed with our own release keys, and served over HTTPS. Add this repository to the F-Droid app to install our apps and receive updates automatically.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://fdroid.aimlds.org/repo
